question: What is MiniPOS?
answer: MiniPOS is a web-based point-of-sale platform for restaurants, retail shops, and online stores. One account can manage multiple shops — each with its own POS terminal, kitchen display, QR table ordering, staff, and reports.

question: Do I need to install anything?
answer: No. MiniPOS runs entirely in your browser. Open minipos.site, sign up, and start selling — no download, no app store.

question: What devices can I use it on?
answer: Any device with a modern browser — phone, tablet, laptop, or desktop. The POS terminal is optimized for tablets and desktops. The QR ordering menu works on any customer's phone.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Go to minipos.site, click "Get started free", fill in your name, email, and password. You'll receive a verification email — click the link to activate your account, then sign in.

question: How much does MiniPOS cost?
answer: MiniPOS is completely free during our early access period. No credit card required. When we launch paid plans in the future, existing accounts will keep access to a free tier with core features — you won't lose what you have.

question: Is there a free plan?
answer: Yes. MiniPOS will always have a free plan. The free tier will include core POS features with reasonable limits. Advanced features like detailed analytics, unlimited shops, and priority support will be part of paid plans.

question: What will paid plans include?
answer: We haven't finalized pricing yet. When paid plans launch, they'll include higher limits, additional features, and dedicated support. We'll notify all existing users before any changes take effect.

question: Will I be charged automatically when paid plans launch?
answer: No. You will never be charged without explicitly choosing a paid plan. Free tier users remain on the free plan unless they upgrade.

question: How do I cancel my account?
answer: Contact us at support@minipos.site and we'll handle it promptly. Your data will be removed within 7 days.

question: What features does MiniPOS include?
answer: POS terminal with PIN-based staff login, Kitchen Display System (KDS) with real-time order tickets, QR table ordering for customers, multi-shop dashboard, daily sales reports, shift management, refunds, staff roles, and device management.

question: Can I manage multiple shops?
answer: Yes. One account can manage multiple shops, each with its own products, staff, tables, and reports.

question: Can my staff use it?
answer: Yes. You can add staff with four roles — Owner, Manager, Cashier, and Chef — each with different permissions. Cashiers and Chefs use a PIN to log into POS and kitchen terminals.

question: Can customers order from their phone?
answer: Yes. Each table gets a QR code. Customers scan it, browse the menu, and place orders directly — no app install needed. Orders appear on the kitchen display in real time.

question: Can I see sales reports?
answer: Yes. MiniPOS shows daily sales summaries, peak hours, top products, revenue by channel, shift logs, and refund history.

question: Does it work offline?
answer: No. MiniPOS requires an internet connection. All data is processed and stored on the server in real time.

question: Can I print receipts?
answer: Currently receipts can be printed via the browser print function. Dedicated receipt printer support is planned for a future update.

question: What payment methods does MiniPOS support?
answer: MiniPOS records any payment method you accept — cash, bank transfer, or mobile payments. It tracks what was paid and how, but does not process card or mobile payments directly. Payment gateway integration is planned for a future update.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: On the login page, click "Forgot password?", enter your email, and we'll send a reset link valid for 1 hour. Click the link and set a new password.

question: Is my data safe?
answer: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit via HTTPS. Passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text. Authentication uses secure HttpOnly cookies. All financial actions are audit logged.

question: Can someone else access my account?
answer: Only you can access your account with your email and password. Each shop's data is fully isolated from other accounts. Staff members access POS terminals via PIN only — they cannot log into your main account.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Email support@minipos.site or use the contact form at minipos.site. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

question: How do I start using the POS terminal?
answer: Go to your shop → POS. A device request will be sent to the shop owner for approval. Once approved, the terminal unlocks and staff can log in with their PIN.

question: Why is my POS terminal showing "Device Pending"?
answer: Every POS device must be approved by the shop owner before it can be used. Go to Shop → Permissions → approve the device. This prevents unauthorized devices from accessing your POS.

question: How do staff log into the POS?
answer: Staff enter their 4-digit PIN on the POS login screen. No email or password needed — PIN is fast and designed for shared terminals.

question: Can multiple cashiers use the same terminal?
answer: Yes. Each cashier logs in with their own PIN and logs out after their shift. The terminal is shared but each session is tracked individually.

question: What happens if a cashier forgets their PIN?
answer: The shop owner or manager can reset a staff member's PIN from Shop → Staff.

question: Can I revoke a device?
answer: Yes. Go to Shop → Permissions → revoke the device. It will immediately lose access and return to pending status.

question: Can I process refunds on the POS?
answer: Yes. Managers and owners can issue refunds from the order history on the POS terminal.

question: How does the kitchen display work?
answer: When a cashier places an order on the POS (or a customer orders via QR), the ticket appears on the kitchen screen in real time — no refresh needed.

question: How do kitchen staff log in?
answer: Kitchen staff enter their PIN on the kitchen login screen. No email or password needed.

question: How do kitchen staff mark an order as done?
answer: Each ticket has a status button. Staff tap it to move the order through the stages — New → Preparing → Ready. The status updates in real time across all screens.

question: Can the kitchen display and POS run on separate devices?
answer: Yes — that's the intended setup. Kitchen screen on a tablet in the kitchen, POS terminal at the counter. Both stay in sync in real time.

question: What happens if the kitchen screen loses internet?
answer: New orders won't appear until reconnected. Refresh the page to reconnect — tickets will reload automatically.

question: Why does it say "Device Pending" when I open the POS?
answer: The first time any device opens your POS or kitchen URL, it registers itself and waits for owner approval. This is a security feature — only approved devices can operate.

question: Where do I approve a device?
answer: Sign in to your shop dashboard → go to Shop → Permissions → you'll see the pending device with its name and timestamp. Click Approve.

question: Can I approve devices from my phone?
answer: Yes — the shop dashboard works on any browser including mobile.

question: What if I accidentally approved the wrong device?
answer: Go to Shop → Permissions → revoke it. The device will return to pending and cannot process any orders.

question: How many devices can I approve?
answer: No limit. You can run multiple POS terminals and kitchen screens simultaneously across the same shop.

question: How do I add a product?
answer: Go to Shop → Products → click "Add product". Enter the name, price, category, and optional description. The product appears on the POS and QR menu immediately.

question: Can I have product variants?
answer: Yes. Each product can have multiple variants — for example a drink can have Small, Medium, and Large with different prices.

question: Can I add modifiers to products?
answer: Yes. You can create modifier groups (e.g. "Add-ons", "Spice level") with options customers can select when ordering.

question: Can I organize products into categories?
answer: Yes. Create categories under Shop → Products. Categories appear as tabs on the POS and QR menu for fast navigation.

question: Can I hide a product without deleting it?
answer: Yes. Mark a product as inactive — it disappears from the POS and QR menu but stays in your product list for easy reactivation.

question: Can I delete a product?
answer: Yes. Deleting a product removes it from the menu. Historical orders that included the product are not affected.

question: How many products can I add?
answer: No limit during early access. Limits may apply on the free tier when paid plans launch — we'll communicate this clearly in advance.

question: What is a product variant?
answer: A variant is a version of the same product with a different size or price. For example, "Milk Tea" can have variants: Small ($2), Medium ($3), Large ($4). Each variant has its own price.

question: How do I add variants to a product?
answer: When creating or editing a product, scroll to the Items section → click "Add item" → enter the variant name and price. At least one item is required per product.

question: Can different variants have different prices?
answer: Yes — each variant has its own price. You can also set a variant to $0 if it's included at no extra cost.

question: How do variants appear on the POS?
answer: When a cashier taps a product, a selection popup shows all variants. They pick one to add to the cart.

question: How do variants appear on the QR menu?
answer: Customers see all available variants listed under the product. They select one before adding to their order.

question: Can I have a product with only one variant?
answer: Yes — most simple products have one item at one price. Multiple variants are only needed when the same product comes in different sizes or versions.

question: What is a modifier?
answer: A modifier is an optional or required add-on customers can choose when ordering. For example, "Spice Level" (Mild / Medium / Spicy) or "Add-ons" (Extra cheese +$0.50, No onion — free).

question: What is a modifier group?
answer: A modifier group is a set of related options under one label. For example — Group: "Add-ons" → options: Extra cheese (+$0.50), Extra sauce (+$0.30), No onion (free). You can attach one group to many products.

question: How do I create a modifier group?
answer: Go to Shop → Products → Modifiers → click "Add modifier group" → give it a name → add options with names and prices (0 if free).

question: How do I attach a modifier to a product?
answer: When creating or editing a product, scroll to the Modifiers section → select which modifier groups apply. One group can be shared across multiple products.

question: Can I make a modifier required?
answer: Yes. Set the modifier group as required — customers must select at least one option before adding the item to their order.

question: Can customers select multiple modifier options?
answer: Yes. Each modifier group has a max select setting — set to 1 for single choice (e.g. spice level), or higher for multiple selections (e.g. toppings).

question: Do modifier prices add to the total?
answer: Yes. Modifier option prices are added on top of the variant price automatically.

question: Where do modifiers show on the QR menu?
answer: After a customer selects a product and variant, a modifier screen appears before adding to cart. Required groups must be completed before they can proceed.

question: Do modifiers show on the kitchen display?
answer: Yes. Each kitchen ticket shows the selected modifiers per item — e.g. "Milk Tea (Large) — Extra sugar, Less ice".

question: Can I use modifiers on the POS too?
answer: Yes. When a cashier adds a product to the cart, modifier options appear as a popup. The cashier selects on behalf of the customer.

question: What plan am I on?
answer: All accounts are on the Free plan during early access. You can check your current plan and usage at minipos.site/plan.

question: How many shops can I create?
answer: The Free plan allows up to 3 shops. Your existing shops are never affected if you hit the limit — you just can't add new ones until you upgrade.

question: How many products can I add per shop?
answer: The Free plan allows up to 200 products per shop. This is a generous limit for most small businesses. Higher limits will be available on paid plans.

question: How many staff can I add per shop?
answer: The Free plan allows up to 10 staff members per shop.

question: How many tables can I add per shop?
answer: The Free plan allows up to 20 tables per shop.

question: What happens when I reach a limit?
answer: You'll see a message explaining which limit you've hit. Your existing data — shops, products, staff, tables — continues working normally. You just can't add more until you upgrade or a limit is raised.

question: Will my existing shops or products be deleted if I hit a limit?
answer: No. Hitting a plan limit never deletes or disables anything you've already created. It only prevents adding new items above the limit.

question: When will paid plans be available?
answer: Paid plans are coming soon. We'll notify all users before launch. Contact support@minipos.site if you need higher limits now and we'll work something out.

question: How do I upgrade my plan?
answer: Paid plans are not yet available. When they launch, you'll be able to upgrade from the Plan page (minipos.site/plan). For early access, contact support@minipos.site.

question: Where can I see my current usage?
answer: Go to minipos.site/plan. It shows your current plan, how many shops you've used, and what's included in your tier.
